dataset.description:
The interdisciplinary research project GENOCON is focused on a phenomenon known as "conspirituality," which combines conspiratorial thinking with New Age spirituality. The project aims to analyze the origin, development, and convergence of conspiracy theories and New Age ideas in the 20th century, when Latvia faced significant challenges. Conspirituality involves merging conspiracy mentality with New Age spirituality, and the project will delve into its history and development. The dataset includes draft articles, conference papers, presentations, recordings of
theoretical seminars, and other research materials.
dataset.title: Genealogy of Conspirituality in Latvia
